correctness.rationale: After x=u/K−1, y=v, s=x+By/2 and A=a/(bK+c), B=β/(K+γ), H=K/(K+γ), L=2k+B(1+H), the exact two-fold analytic map has leading s=s−(4/3)s³−2Lsy+O(s^5+s³y+sy²+y³), y=y−2Ay²+O(|s|y²+y³). Independent rational polynomial Taylor expansion at (B,H,k,A,J)=(1/5,1/2,1/50,1,1/2) verified −4/3 and −17/25=−2L, cancellation of s²y and y², but found positive pure y³ at s=0. Thus the RESULT.md phrase that s decreases on the whole small rectangle 0<s,y<δ is literally too broad; the actual claimed wedge s>y^q (q>max(p,1/2), q<1) avoids this: its lower boundary ratio increases by 2A(q−p)y−(4/3)y^{2q}+o(y), and within it negative cubic/mixed drift dominates y³. This suffices for wedge invariance and positivity. Reciprocal y gives y_n~1/(An); the inverse-square even-iterate R=1/s_(2m)^2 satisfies R_(m+1)=[1+2p/m+summable ε_m]R_m+8/3+o(1) using the wedge, y~1/(2Am), s²=O(1/m); product asymptotics produce universal sqrt3(1−2p)/2 for p<1/2, sqrt3/2 at p=1/2 with log correction, positive initial-data-dependent C for p>1/2. Finite diagnostic tests not infinite proofs. The inaccurate rectangle-wide ancillary statement should be corrected by owner before public release, without changing the scientific conclusion.
